Kangaroo Sound Jumps

How many sounds live in each word? Tap one jump circle per sound.

Play with sound ↓Print the worksheet ↓Works with a finger, a stylus, or a mouse. Sound plays from the page.
PLAY · SOUND COUNTING (PHONEMES) · WITH SOUND

Kangaroo Sound Jumps

Play the word, say it slowly, and tap one circle for every sound you hear. Then check!

Every jump counted!

You can hear the sounds inside words — the deepest listening skill of all.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

This game trains sound counting (phonemes) with real recorded audio and generous feedback. A miss is met with a hint and a replay button, never a penalty — the habit being built is listening again, not being right first time. The sounds are played as pure sounds (sss, not “suh”), which is exactly how reading research says to teach them.

Prefer paper? The Kangaroo Sound Jumps worksheet brings the same activity to the kitchen table with a parent-read sound script and an answer line — printing a worksheet never marks a class complete.
